name: refund
effect: *Refund is when you regain Strain. Increasing it by that amount. You cannot have more Strain then your Max Strain.*
short: Gain X Strain. You cannot have more Strain then your Max Strain.

name: break
effect:
A Break when you spend at least 30 minutes doing something you would find relaxing, such as reading, sleeping, exercise, meditation, etc. Again a Break must be a minimum of 30 minutes, after which you Refund all Strain (gain Max Strain) and refresh/end on Break effects.
- You can take up to 3 Breaks before you must Rest.
short: Spend 30 or more minutes of relaxation. Refund all Strain after.

name: rest
effect: A Rest is when you spend at least 8 hours doing something non-strenuous and/or relaxing, such as reading, sleeping, exercise, meditation, etc. Typically this is spent and the end of a day or after a main encounter. Again a Rest must be a minimum of 8 hours, after which you Heal to full (gain Max Health), Refund all Strain (gain Max Strain), loose all Death's Door you have, and refresh/end on Rest effects.
short: Spend 8 or more hours of relaxation. Heal to full, Refund all Strain, and lose all Death's Door after.

name: death's door
effect:
- At 1 or more stacks of Death's Door you are permanently Slowed.
- At 2 stacks of Death's Door you become Unconscious until a creature heals you to half health or more. Then you permanently have 4 Stun.
- At 3 stacks of Death's Door you die.
You lose all stacks of Death's Door at the end of a Rest.

name: bleeding out
effect: Gained when you have 0 or less health. At the end of your turn roll a d12. If you roll a 6 or less you gain a stack of Death's Door. If you roll a 7 or higher, another creature heals you, or another creature rolls a 9 or higher on a BODY or MIND Check you lose Bleeding Out.
